topic: the WLF time-temperature superposition study applied to corpus policy evolution - reading policy version as the corpus temperature, shift factors, and how the study becomes executable once policy versions accumulate

subtopics.scope: The Williams-Landel-Ferry equation itself: the log(a_T) = -C1*(T-Tref)/(C2+T-Tref) form, the universal constants C1 = 17.4 and C2 = 51.6 K at T_ref = T_g, and what shift factor a_T physically means.
seed_queries: Williams Landel Ferry equation universal constants C1 17.4 C2 51.6 glass transition
WLF shift factor temperature dependence log time scale definition

subtopics.scope: Time-temperature superposition (TTS) as the broader principle: thermorheologically simple materials, master curve construction by horizontal log-time shifting, and when the principle holds or breaks.
seed_queries: time temperature superposition master curve construction principle
thermorheologically simple material definition when superposition fails

subtopics.scope: The mapping from the viscoelastic reading to a software corpus: policy version is the temperature, response curves (latencies, verdicts, retries) are the moduli, and invariant gate structure (gate shape, six terminal states, fail-closed rule) is the material that must not reshape.
seed_queries: configuration policy versioning invariants software system behavior
treat configuration as control parameter analog system dynamics

subtopics.scope: The measurement method: segment response history into per-policy-version windows using an audit event log, build response curves per window (approve latency, verdict distribution, retry behavior, audit cadence), and compute per-version shift factors a_T(v) by superposition fitting along log time.
seed_queries: time series segmentation by configuration version change point
shift factor estimation superposition fitting log time axis

subtopics.scope: Testing thermorheological simplicity on the worker gate: one shift factor per version must superpose ALL curves; if a version bump reshapes a curve (the v4 to v5 validator addition reshaping resend.send outcomes), the analog restricts to rate-only changes.
seed_queries: time temperature superposition failure thermorheologically complex
distribution shift detection after feature release monitoring

subtopics.scope: The proposed instrument: stamp policy_version on every jev_corpus_runs row and keep a compact append-only policy changelog (version, timestamp, diff summary) in a table the wipe protocol never touches, so the method becomes executable after about 2 policy versions of accumulation.
seed_queries: append only changelog table schema design best practices
database schema version stamping observability audit

subtopics.scope: The 2026-10-01 14:44Z data wipe as a case study: the audit event history was removed so policy-change timestamps are not reconstructable from D1, and the general problem of designing wipe-resistant durable ledgers for audit histories.
seed_queries: audit log data loss incident reconstruction postmortem
immutable append only audit log storage design wipe

subtopics.scope: Standing calibration anchors: round 3 prediction-vs-realized dissipation of 102.86 dBc-units over 10 cycles as the hysteresis scale any future WLF comparison must beat before claiming policy-level effects, and effect-size thresholds before claiming a change mattered.
seed_queries: minimum effect size threshold before claiming significant change
prediction calibration error budget baseline methodology

subtopics.scope: The limits of the viscoelastic analogy: what the temperature metaphor hides, when physical analogies mislead software design, and the honest no-numbers reporting discipline (method-complete but data-blocked, no numbers claimed).
seed_queries: physics analogy limits software engineering criticism
isomorphic modeling metaphor risk systems design
